name: asm_bench_O2_verbose_gcc
description: A dataset of compiler-produced assembly (verbose -O2 GCC) intended to benchmark models on assembly understanding and translation tasks. It measures a model's ability to map between high-level code and low-level assembly, reason about compiler optimizations, and generate or interpret annotated assembly output. Examples are useful for code generation, decompilation, and program analysis evaluations.
reputation: A niche, developer-focused dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for assembly/code-translation benchmarking.
